context.person: A person using an employer payroll portal
context.user_goal: Verify both effective dates and report the change immediately if it was unauthorized.

product_state.preceding_state: The employee changed the bank account used for future direct deposits.
product_state.current_state: The new account applies to payrolls processed after September 20. The next paycheck on September 19 still goes to the previous account.
known_facts: The new account applies to payrolls processed after September 20.
The next paycheck on September 19 still goes to the previous account.
A notice was sent to the previous email address.
An unauthorized change can be reported to payroll and the account can be locked.
forbidden_claims: The September 19 paycheck goes to the new account.
The change proves the account is secure.

current_content.subject: An update for you
current_content.heading: You're all set!

challenge: Rewrite the transactional email so the person can understand direct deposit account changed, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.secondary_action: Report an unauthorized change and lock payroll changes.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: One upcoming paycheck still uses the previous account.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Verify both effective dates and report the change immediately if it was unauthorized.
